name: Chenna Rao Borra
researchStatement: My research focuses on developing efficient, sustainable, and environmentally friendly processes for the extraction, recovery, and recycling of valuable and critical metals from primary and secondary resources, including ores, metallurgical wastes, tailings, residues, and end-of-life products. I work on hydrometallurgical, pyrometallurgical, and electrometallurgical processes for metal extraction and recycling, with an emphasis on resource recovery, waste minimization, and circularity. Thermodynamic modelling using HSC Chemistry and FactSage, along with techno-economic analysis (TEA) and life-cycle assessment (LCA), is integrated into my research to understand process behaviour and evaluate the economic and environmental sustainability of the developed processes. Through this integrated approach, my research aims to develop scalable, economically viable, and environmentally sustainable technologies for metal extraction, recovery, and recycling and contribute to the transition towards a circular and resource-efficient metals industry.
